Ben / Lauren — I pulled the history and flagged a few points. Summary below: 

- Trial GX-TRIAL-8421 requested extra credits twice in the last 75 days (2027-02-10 and 2027-03-18). Both were granted (one small 25K, one 40K) after Sales escalations.
- Usage patterns show two distinct API key prefixes and traffic from two VN subnets, suggesting possible parallel team usage.
- No obvious script-based replay (user-agent diversity is high), but the velocity of token consumption is above normal for a single POC team.

My recommendation: do not approve full 150K without conditions. Suggested path:
1) Offer a conditional one-time 50K token top-up tied to a short-term purchase commitment or a strict rate limit profile.
2) Require Procurement to sign the credit_override_form.pdf and accept a usage audit in 30 days.
3) If parallel accounts are confirmed, consolidate credits to a single account before top-up.

I’ve attached trial_request_history.csv and created a brief exception log (policy_exception_log.txt) with the timeline. If Sales wants to push harder, we need Finance sign-off because this would be our third top-up in 75 days for the same org.
